caption: The drawing features two triangular fabric swatches laid out on a plain, light beige or off-white rectangular background that resembles parchment or a textile sample page. The top triangle is positioned near the upper edge and the left triangle is near the lower left corner; both triangles have a similar floral print. The fabric in both triangles is decorated with a dense floral pattern, consisting of green and yellow leaves, red flowers, small white blossoms, and brownish stems, all set against a medium brown background. The top triangle contains mostly green and yellow leaves interspersed with clusters of small white flowers, while the lower left triangle includes red flower clusters in addition to the green leaves and white blossoms. Both triangles have irregular, hand-cut edges and are arranged with their longest sides parallel to the edges of the background. The background is largely empty except for the two textile samples, emphasizing the texture and color of the patterned fabric pieces.
title: Patchwork Bedspread
